To start our discussion on your sporting journey, could you tell me a bit about your history? What kind of athletic activities or competitive environments have defined your life so far?
Options: [Team sports (e.g., basketball, rugby, field sports) | Individual endurance or technical sports (e.g., rowing, swimming, combat sports) | Strength and power disciplines (e.g., weightlifting, track & field) | I am relatively new to structured competitive sport]
Team sports (e.g., basketball, rugby, field sports)

Since you’ve spent time in team environments, how would you describe your role or playing style when the pressure is at its highest?
Options: [The leader and strategist calling the plays | The reliable specialist executing specific tasks | The powerhouse driving the intensity and physical play | The adaptable utility player covering multiple positions]
The powerhouse driving the intensity and physical play

As you look toward the next chapter of your athletic journey, what is the primary goal fueling your interest in taking your physical potential to the next level?
Options: [Pursuing a path toward elite professional competition | Testing my limits to see how far my natural attributes can take me | Mastering the tactical and technical side of a new high-performance discipline | Joining a high-performance squad to contribute to collective success]
Joining a high-performance squad to contribute to collective success

To finalize the picture of your athletic footprint, how would you describe your current training structure: is it a rigid, daily discipline, or are you in the process of building that foundation to support a high-performance workload?
Options: [I follow a rigorous, daily structured regimen | I train consistently but with room to formalize | I am building my structure from the ground up]
I train consistently but with room to formalize
